rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary join key and unique identifier with 100% coverage required for referential integrity.

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty and must uniquely identify each customer record.

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: Referential integrity requires that every S_N in the bio table has a corresponding record in the account info table via one-to-one relationship.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier linking customer bio to account records.

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit numeric codes ranging from 1001-1028; must be stored as categorical string of 4 digits.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Name is a mandatory personal identifier field with 100% population required.

rule: Name must be in Title Case except for recognized lowercase particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Sample shows deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase). Standard naming convention requires Title Case.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if w else False) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is a mandatory unique identifier with no missing values allowed.

rule: ID_No must be unique across all records
rationale: National ID numbers should uniquely identify individuals; sample shows one duplicate 'F1011121T' requiring investigation.

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow standard format. Non-standard formats observed: '1916569C' (missing prefix), 'F212233V' (6 digits instead of 7).

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Sample contains casing variations (MALAY, malay, indian) that should be standardized to Title Case canonical forms.

rule: Gender must be either 'Male' or 'Female' in Title Case
rationale: Sample contains casing variations (male, FEMALE) that must be standardized to canonical Title Case values.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 years inclusive
rationale: Human lifespan domain constraint. Sample contains invalid negative value (-5) and unrealistic value (4) for consumer service.

rule: Age must be numeric parseable (no text representations like 'Twenty-five')
rationale: Sample contains text value 'Twenty-five' which cannot be parsed as numeric, indicating data type contamination.

rule: Age must not be negative
rationale: Age represents a non-negative quantity. Sample contains -5 which is logically impossible.

rule: Age below 13 may be unrealistic for a consumer service account
rationale: Dataset appears to be for consumer service (customer bio). Values 4 and -5 flagged as potentially invalid for service eligibility.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Column has 6.7% missing values (2 records). Contact information is typically required for customer communication.

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, optional +65 prefix)
rationale: Singapore context with country code 65. Sample shows inconsistent formatting and one 7-digit truncated value '8964359'.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a mandatory contact field with 100% population required for customer communication.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Sample contains 4 malformed values: 'not-an-email', 'useremail.com' (no @), 'zx91 @example.com' (space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @).

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore'
rationale: Sample shows 8 variations of Singapore (SINGAPORE, singapore, SG, S'pore, Singapura, 新加坡, Republic of Singapore). Must standardize to canonical form.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory component of the address with 100% population required.

rule: Street_Name must be in Title Case
rationale: Sample contains 'HOLLAND ROAD' in all caps, deviating from the dominant Title Case convention observed in other 29 records.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() if w else False) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits when zero-padded (Singapore standard)
rationale: Singapore postal codes are 6 digits. Stored as int causing loss of leading zeros (e.g., 6907, 99999). Must validate as 6-digit codes.

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match Gender field (Bin/s/o = Male, Binte/d/o = Female)
rationale: Cultural naming conventions in Singapore: Malay/Indian names use Bin/s/o for males and Binte/d/o for females. Sample contains these particles and must align with Gender column.

check_params.logic: name_lower = ' ' + str(row['Name']).lower() + ' '; has_male = ' bin ' in name_lower or ' s/o ' in name_lower; has_female = ' binte ' in name_lower or ' d/o ' in name_lower; gender_lower = str(row['Gender']).strip().lower(); (has_male and gender_lower != 'male') or (has_female and gender_lower != 'female')

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty when joined on S_N (accounting for standardization)
rationale: S_N is one-to-one join key. Name and Full_Name represent the same customer attribute and must be consistent across tables after case/format standardization.

check_params.semantic_check: Name should match Full_Name when joined on S_N (accounting for case and formatting differences)

rule: ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty when joined on S_N
rationale: S_N is one-to-one join key. ID_No and ID are national identifier fields representing the same customer and must match exactly across tables.

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No should exactly match ID when joined on S_N

rule: Account_No must match Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty when joined on S_N
rationale: S_N is one-to-one join key. Account_No should be consistent across both tables for the same customer record.

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No should match Acc_Info_dirty.Account_No when joined on S_N

rule: Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 93.3% distinct with duplicate value(s) [1001, 1010] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['thm@example.com'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 6 digits (derived from data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.
